title: Josiah says Auntie told an angel to tell him something

tellings.quote: e Auntie told an angel to tell me auntie was my great aunt and she died at age 89

plain: The mother of a boy named Josiah says that when he was about 7 or 8, he told her that "Auntie" had told an angel to tell him something. She explains that Auntie was his great aunt, who had died at age 89. She tells it on a podcast about children said to read minds, linked to a work called Josiah's Fire, as a hint that the boy received a message from someone who had died.
